correctness.rationale: The full 256-element trace-zero algebra and all 65,536 ordered pairs were enumerated exhaustively. The proof explains why bracket-basis closure and independent adjoint-operator closure compute the exact same generated Lie subalgebra, and both independently ordered procedures give the precise nine-bin histogram. A verified six-dimensional parabolic and exact GL3(F2) stabilizer check substantiate the dimension gap and 80 conjugacy orbits. The code is replayable; no unproved infinite claim is made.

value.rationale: This exact complete first binary rank-three Lie-generation profile fills a natural finite base case in contemporary random-generation work. Its zero six-dimensional two-generator count contrasts with an existing six-dimensional parabolic, a structural obstruction rather than merely a bare success probability. Counting 80 free conjugacy classes gives an additional natural isomorphism-reduced invariant, and the transparent complete enumerator is reusable as a small-field benchmark.
